title: Power Automate process mining: custom KPIs in the process intelligence experience
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing background and ownership controls are supported. It distinguishes the roadmap's custom-KPI capabilities from the narrower Learn documentation and clearly identifies the remaining documentation gaps.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 576868 introduces custom KPIs in the Power Automate process mining process intelligence experience.
claims.quote: This feature enables you to define custom KPIs and metrics tailored to specific business requirements within the process intelligence experience.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet document creating custom KPIs in this experience, and the linked KPI card page does not mention custom metrics.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPI admin switch permissions licensing capacity custom metrics; opened learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/process-mining-studio-kpi-card and process-mining-studio-overview. Neither describes custom-KPI creation.

claims.claim: Learn documents custom metrics for the Power Automate Process Mining desktop app.
claims.quote: The custom metric editor indicates the result is applicable everywhere in the Power Automate Process Mining desktop app.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that the desktop custom-metric documentation describes custom KPIs in this web experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPI admin switch permissions licensing capacity custom metrics; read minit/custom-metrics-beginner-examples, minit/data-types-custom-metrics search excerpt, process-mining-studio-kpi-card and process-mining-studio-overview on learn.microsoft.com.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no administrator switch to turn this custom-KPI capability on or off as of November 2026.

claims.claim: No new identity, permission or role is described specifically for custom KPIs.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: No license specific to custom KPIs in the process intelligence experience is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "process intelligence" "custom KPIs" license capacity pricing. Read Learn process-advisor-overview licensing, process-mining-studio-kpi-card and the powerapps-flow-licensing-faq process mining excerpts; no custom-KPI-specific license is named.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate custom-KPI price or specified whether creating or evaluating one consumes capacity or another meter.
claims.quote: Searched: "process intelligence" "custom KPIs" license capacity pricing. Read Learn process-advisor-overview, process-mining-studio-kpi-card and powerapps-flow-licensing-faq process mining excerpts; storage capacity is documented, but no KPI creation/evaluation charge is stated.

claims.claim: Process mining requires a Power Platform environment with a Dataverse database.
claims.quote: A Microsoft Power Platform environment with a Microsoft Dataverse database.

claims.claim: Dataverse storage is a related process mining cost.
claims.quote: Depending on the size of the process data you import, you might run out of Dataverse storage capacity. If this happens, ask your admin about purchasing more storage capacity, or delete existing processes to free up storage.

claims.claim: Feature-specific rollout mechanics beyond the roadmap target and Launched status are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process mining custom KPIs process intelligence experience rollout release availability. Read roadmap record and Learn process-mining-studio-overview and process-mining-studio-kpi-card; search returned no feature-specific rollout schedule or mechanism.

claims.claim: Duplicate tab copies the tab with all its cards and layout.
claims.quote: Duplicate tab: Create a copy of the tab with all its cards and layout.

claims.claim: Process ownership reassignment is reached in Power Platform admin center through environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Reassign records.
claims.quote: Select the environment where the process is located. [...] select Settings. [...] Under Users + permissions, select Users. [...] Select the leaving user. [...] select Reassign records.

claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/msdyn_pminferredtasks(<msdyn_pminferredtaskid>) with Content-Type: application/json and body {"ownerid@odata.bind":"systemusers(<new-owner-systemuserid>)"} updates the process owner.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/msdyn_pminferredtasks; Operations supported: POSTGETPATCHDELETE; Single-valued navigation properties: ownerid | principal | owner_msdyn_pminferredtask

claims.claim: The target of reassignment needs appropriate privileges on the entities associated with the transferred records.
claims.quote: The target user should have the appropriate privileges on the different entities associated with the transferred records.

claims.claim: Environment Maker is sufficient for the target user when reassigning a process mining process.
claims.quote: For process mining process, giving the Environment Maker role is sufficient.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Reassign records transfers all records of the selected user rather than only one process.
claims.quote: In the Assign to field, use the dropdown menu to assign all the records to either the administrator or another user.

claims.claim: Dataverse represents process ownership reassignment as Assign, implemented through a PATCH updating ownerid.
claims.quote: Assign [...] PATCH /msdyn_pminferredtasks(msdyn_pminferredtaskid) [...] Update the ownerid property.

claims.claim: Process mining access is governed by environment security and Dataverse security roles and privileges.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a custom-KPI-specific permission or control restricting who can define or edit one.

Read Learn process-advisor-security, process-mining-studio-kpi-card and process-mining-studio-overview.

claims.claim: The mixed licensing model reflects the documented per-user Premium license and tenant-wide Process Mining add-on, without claiming a separate custom-KPI license.
